summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E test expansion and staging baselines) for the cipher-box project, including account cleanup helpers, media/streaming test suites, batch download tests, and capturing staging performance baselines.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed successfully: shared deleteAccountViaPage helper wired into 10 specs, media/streaming and batch download test suites created (21 new tests), staging journey timing and 200-client SDK load baselines captured. PR #392 created with BYO-IPFS load test workflow support added to GitHub Actions.

repo: Playwright config's baseURL doesn't respect BASE_URL env var by default — needs explicit process.env.BASE_URL override in playwright.config.ts, plus webServer must be conditionally omitted when targeting staging
Staging Web3Auth (Core Kit) initialization takes 22-23 seconds before the wallet button becomes interactive — test timeouts must account for this
SDK load tests use destroyClientPool() -> deleteTestAccount() (direct API call, no browser); browser load tests use deleteAccountViaPage(page) (fetch via browser cookies) — these are distinct paths
Running two SDK load test suites simultaneously against staging saturates the instance even with throttle bypass header — tests must run solo
The throttle bypass header (X-Throttle-Bypass) works correctly in all environments; what appeared as a bypass failure was actually resource contention from concurrent test runs
Pinata free tier gets exhausted quickly when used for load testing — byo-capacity-ceiling ran 50+100+200+500+1000 client tiers and exhausted the quota
Vitest does not automatically load .env files — requires explicit shell env sourcing (set -a; source .env; set +a) before running vitest
BYO register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging when using Pinata provider — pinning succeeds but CipherBox API rejects CID registration (test account likely not configured for BYO mode)

code.finding: API URL for account deletion must be derived from the page URL, not hardcoded to localhost:3000 — staging pages would call localhost otherwise
Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer skip — required for running E2E tests against staging environments
No built-in dotenv loading — must source .env before invoking vitest via shell
Used existsSync + unlinkSync (TOCTOU anti-pattern) for corrupt file cleanup — replaced with try/catch and try/finally to ensure cleanup

workflow: GSD wave execution with worktrees can cause STATE.md merge conflicts when cherry-picking — expect and resolve these during wave merges
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error from Claude Code is a runtime bug, not a plan failure — spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits to confirm actual success
Running load tests in parallel against the same staging instance causes false throttle failures — always run load tests sequentially against shared environments
Browser-based Playwright load tests (5 Chromium tabs) provide inferior signal compared to headless SDK client tests (200 clients) — the former measures browser overhead, not API capacity

friction: Cherry-picking worktree commits to phase branch caused repeated STATE.md merge conflicts requiring manual resolution
Git lock files from failed/killed worktree agents required force-removing stale worktrees before retrying plans
Pinata free tier exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling test — all pin operations returned 402 after initial runs
SSH to VPS for staging secret inspection timed out (1Password SSH key issue), requiring alternative diagnostic approach
Sustained load test ran concurrently with BYO ceiling test, causing apparent throttle bypass failures that were actually resource exhaustion — root cause diagnosis took several investigation cycles
34-03 agent hit a git lock from 34-02's worktree and had to be retried
Phase was prematurely marked complete in ROADMAP.md before meaningful load test baselines were captured — required manually reverting the completion commit
